items.h: A bill, draft IRR, proposal or mere threat is not ripe (Montesclaros; Lozano; PACU).
A supervening event ends the controversy; four exceptions (grave violation, exceptional character, guiding principles, capable of repetition yet evading review).
Citizen, taxpayer, voter, legislator, association or third party, environmental; transcendental importance.
Congress executing laws, the Executive legislating, or either intruding on the courts or independent bodies.
Committee approval of rules, deputizing agencies, legislators identifying projects (ABAKADA; Belgica).
Congress cannot add to qualifications the Constitution fixes (SJS v. DDB); statutory offices differ.
The law must set the policy and the limits; no subdelegation to private parties (Vera; KMU).
Authorized, within scope, proper procedure, reasonable; published (Tañada); filed with ONAR.
